# bioexcel/biobb_gromacs/ndx2resttop

## Summary

Generate a restrained topology from an index NDX file.

This module automatizes the process of restrained topology generation starting from an index NDX file.

Nextflow adapter of the [Ndx2resttop](https://biobb-gromacs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/gromacs_extra.html#gromacs-extra-ndx2resttop-module) building block of [biobb_gromacs](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_gromacs) 5.3.2.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_GROMACS_NDX2RESTTOP } from 'bioexcel/biobb_gromacs/ndx2resttop'

workflow {
    BIOBB_GROMACS_NDX2RESTTOP(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_ndx_path` | yes | ndx | Path to the input NDX index file |
| `input_top_zip_path` | yes | zip | Path the input TOP topology in zip format |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_top_zip_path` | yes | zip | Path the output TOP topology in zip format |
| `versions_biobb_gromacs` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_gromacs', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of Ndx2resttop properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_top_zip_path: 'zip']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_gromacs container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_GROMACS_NDX2RESTTOP' {
        ext.properties = [posres_names: 'CUSTOM_POSRES']
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `posres_names` | string | "CUSTOM_POSRES" | Space-separated preprocessor macro names, one per triplet (e.g. ``"CHAIN_A_POSRES CHAIN_B_POSRES"``). Activated at grompp time via ``-D <name>``. Must match the length of ref_rest_mol_triplet_list. |
| `force_constants` | string | "500 500 500" | Three space-separated force constants Fx Fy Fz in kJ/mol/nm². Written verbatim into each ITP line so the same value is applied to every restrained atom. |
| `ref_rest_mol_triplet_list` | string | null | Comma-separated triplets ``(reference_group, restrain_group, molecule_name)``, one per molecule to restrain.``reference_group``: NDX group containing *all* atoms of the molecule in global (system-wide) GROMACS numbering. Used only as a coordinate frame to convert global indices to molecule-local 1-based indices. Example: ``r_1-9280``. ``restrain_group``: NDX group with the subset of atoms to actually restrain (must be a strict subset of reference_group). Example: ``P_&_r_1-9280``. ``molecule_name``: the ``[ moleculetype ]`` name in the topology used to locate where to splice the ``#ifdef`` block. Example: ``1TSR``. |
